# RDF4J

Eclipse RDF4J — the successor to the OpenRDF Sesame framework — is a Java library for storing,
inferring over and querying RDF. `Information-Systems-Modelling` lab 5 uses **3.6.3**, pulled in via
`rdf4j-bom` + `rdf4j-storage`, and it is the only triple store in the source set. (The other graph
technology in the corpus is [[neo4j]], which is a labelled property graph, not RDF — different data
model, different query language.)

## What lab 5 uses it for

Six classes, ~one job each:

| Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `RepositoryFactory` | `inMemoryWithRdfs()` — an in-memory store wrapped in an **RDFS inferencer** |
| `OntologyLoader` | loads Turtle from the classpath into a named context |
| `Vocabulary` | namespace and IRI constants |
| `SampleDataWriter` | adds triples through the model API rather than from a file |
| `QueryRunner` | eight SPARQL `SELECT` queries |
| `App` | `main` — build store, load TBox + ABox, add triples, query, shut down |

The store is **in-memory only**. Nothing persists between runs, there is no native store directory,
no HTTP SPARQL endpoint and no RDF4J Server/Workbench deployment. Everything is rebuilt from
`ontology.ttl` and `sample-data.ttl` on each `main`.

## The inferencer is the point

`RepositoryFactory.inMemoryWithRdfs()` is one line of configuration that changes what the queries
mean. Two of the eight queries exist to demonstrate it — `listInferredKnowsLinks` returns symmetric
`knows` links nobody asserted in that direction, and `listTransitiveCommunityMembership` walks a
transitive chain. The other six are ordinary retrieval and would work over a plain store.

That split — some queries answered by the data, some by the reasoner — is the whole content of
[[ontology-modelling-tbox-abox]] made executable.

## An outlier in the build

Lab 5 is the only Java module in the repo on **Java 11** while labs 2–4 are on **Java 21**, and the
only one whose `pom.xml` contains no Spring at all: `rdf4j-bom`, `rdf4j-storage`, slf4j 1.7.36,
log4j2 2.17.2, `maven-compiler-plugin`, `exec-maven-plugin` 3.1.0. It is also the only Maven module
**without an `mvnw` wrapper**, so the root README's promise of "or use the bundled wrapper" does not
hold here — an instance of [[documentation-drift]]. See [[maven]].

The package name is `pl.edu.pwr.modellingclub`, not the `pl.edu.pwr.tkubik.ism` used by labs 2–4,
and the directory is named `sesameExample_sol` — Sesame being RDF4J's former name.

statements and answers eight queries"; the eight queries are verifiable by reading `QueryRunner`, the
